subject: Aegle Health pilot — special pricing carveout and exec clearance
messages:
From: Danielle Shaw <d.shaw@aeglehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Boone <alex.boone@aeglehealth.com>, procurement@aeglehealth.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask: pricing and packaging for cardiovascular cohort

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood's low-latency embeddings for our cardiac-readmission model. We need a small confined pilot (4 weeks) that will process historical EHR batches and then a short live evaluation.

A few asks from procurement:
- Target pilot window: 30 days, estimated 150k tokens/day during analysis phase
- Desired per-token pilot rate and any pilot-only discounts we can extend
- Packaging: need VPC option and audit logs for PHI handling (we raised this in SOC2 questionnaire)
- Billing: procurement requires a committed spend floor or a letter of intent to move to a 12-month commitment if pilot is successful

Can you share a proposal and whether Redwood can offer a one-time onboarding credit or stepped pricing for the first 3 months? Budget owner is Danielle Shaw, CFO will need visibility if discount exceeds standard threshold.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — are you able to get something by early next week?

Best,
Danielle
Danielle Shaw
Head of Data Programs, Aegle Health
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Shaw <d.shaw@aeglehealth.com>
Cc: Alex Boone <alex.boone@aeglehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: pricing and packaging for cardiovascular cohort

Hi Danielle — great to connect.

We can definitely support a 30-day pilot with VPC and audit logs. I put together a short starter proposal (attached) with two options:
- Option A (conservative): standard pilot rates with a $2,500 onboarding credit, no long-term commitment required
- Option B (accelerated path): 35% concession on per-token pilot rates and a 3-month stepped discount if Aegle commits to a 12-month minimum within 45 days of pilot completion (recommended for faster throughput and priority capacity)

Two notes:
1) The 35% concession in Option B exceeds threshold that requires exec signoff (VP/CFO).
2) We’ll need procurement to sign a short mutual action plan (MAP) that documents the commitment trigger and data-handling checklist.

I’m looping in Marissa from pricing to formalize the concession language and prepare an internal memo for approval.

Can your team confirm whether they can sign a 12-month LOI if the pilot meets acceptance criteria? That will speed approvals.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Aegle Health pilot — pricing concession request (exec memo attached)

Markus / Priyom — forwarding Aegle's pilot request. Mina proposed Option B (35% concession + 3-month stepped discount tied to 12-month LOI). That 35% is outside of standard delegated authority; per our pricing guardrails this requires VP or CFO clearance.

Executive memo (attached) summarizes:
- Recommended concession: 35% off list pilot per-token for first 30 days; if Aegle signs 12-month commit within 45 days of pilot completion, apply 20% discount on billed usage for months 1–3 of the committed period (to smooth adoption)
- Constraints: commit floor of $45k ARR equivalent for the 12-month contract; onboarding credit capped at $5k (non-recoupable)
- Customer rationale: potential enterprise conversion within 6 months, strong clinical validation partner, strategic presence in Midwest health system network
- Risk: >30% discount increases unit economics impact on GPU utilization for first 90 days; recommend a one-time capacity surcharge ($0.01/token) if burst utilization exceeds projection

Attachments: exec_memo_aegle_special_pricing.pdf, aegle_pricing_model_v3.xlsx

Ask: Please provide signoff or escalated comments by EOD Tue (20 Apr). I can incorporate any edits into the memo and prepare a signature-ready sheet for CFO approval.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Pricing Strategy — Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aegle Health pilot — pricing concession request (exec memo attached)

Marissa / team — reviewed the memo and model. Approve the concession with one modification: replace the open-ended capacity surcharge with a tiered overage clause tied to actual daily token usage (if daily peak exceeds 200k tokens, surcharge applies at $0.015/token beyond that threshold).

Also ensure the MAP has a clear acceptance criteria section (handoff signal) so we avoid ambiguity on conversion triggers. With those edits, approve to proceed and I'll sign the clearance sheet on behalf of the revenue org.

On approval, Mina please route the finalized sheet to Finance for CFO countersign (cc: finance-approvals@redwood.com).

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Shaw <d.shaw@aeglehealth.com>, Alex Boone <alex.boone@aeglehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, procurement@aeglehealth.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: pricing and packaging for cardiovascular cohort — approved concession and next steps

Hi Danielle / Alex — quick update and confirmation of the pilot terms we discussed:

- Pilot duration: 30 days (start date to be scheduled)
- Pilot rate concession: 35% off list per-token for pilot window (approved by Redwood VP Revenue Ops)
- Onboarding credit: $5,000 (one-time)
- Commit trigger: 12-month LOI signed within 45 days of pilot completion to unlock the 3-month stepped discount (20% on billed usage for months 1–3 of the committed period)
- Commit floor: $45k ARR equivalent required for the 12-month agreement
- Overage protection: if daily peak usage exceeds 200k tokens, overage applies at $0.015/token beyond threshold (as discussed)
- Security: VPC deployment with audit logging; SOC2 evidence link in shared Drive

I’ve attached the signature-ready concession sheet and exec memo. Please confirm acceptance of the terms and a tentative pilot start week (we have engineering capacity 10 May onward). Procurement, if you agree, sign the attached MAP and return to me and we will route for final Finance/CFO countersign.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
